what: open_experiments #36: a strength dial on FastH3's gates. FastH3 V2 through MiniMaxH3OverlayLoader with every piece and gate_scale 0.75 and 0.5 on three scenes, and 0 on look_anchor, on FastH3's contract harness (10/3, its rungs, euler, core VSA keep 20%), seed 730451892, each scene at its written length. Graphs: bench/make_overlay_loader_graphs.py --out-dir internal/overlay_graphs (scratch, gitignored). Alpha 1 is the loader's own bit-exact FastH3: look_anchor's is look_anchor__overlay_all in 2026-09-29_overlay_loader_render.jsonl; the other two scenes render it here as <scene>__overlay_all.
why: FastH3 has the most fine detail on every scene and the owner reads it as over-polished (fasth3-gate-dial). #35 (2026-09-29_fasth3_gates.md) put the look in the gates. Core computes the coarse branch's gate as gate(xc) with no activation, and the gate rows are int8 with a per-row fp32 scale and no bias, so gate_scale multiplies the gate exactly.

predictions.written: 2026-09-29, before any render, by h3dude; all reasoned, none measured
predictions.D1: detail and hf fall monotonically from alpha 1 to 0.75 to 0.5 on all three scenes.
predictions.D2: moved_share falls with them: #35's no-gates arm lost motion (moved share) as well as detail, so the gates carry both and the dial is not a detail-only control. It ships as a look dial, not as 'less polish, same motion'.
predictions.D3: alpha 0 (look_anchor) lands where fasth3_nogates did on tone, resolution and moved share: a zero gate removes the coarse branch's contribution, so it separates 'the gate values' from 'the branch's presence' only if it differs from the no-gates arm. If it matches, presence of nonzero gates is what matters and the values are not tested by this dial.
predictions.falsifiers: D1: any scene where detail rises from 1 to 0.5. D2: moved_share at 0.5 within 10% of alpha 1 while detail at 0.5 is below 0.8 of alpha 1 on the same scene (then detail and motion separate and the dial ships as a detail control). D3: alpha 0 far from fasth3_nogates on those measures (then the no-gates arm differs by more than a zero coarse gate).
